QuestInfo.name: Alarm Course
QuestInfo.0: #p3000000# has sent word for you. What could it be?
QuestInfo.1: According to #p3000000# , Magnus has already begun his attack! Defenses aren't ready, the knights are still trying to get to their posts... Maybe you can help!
QuestInfo.2: You've decided to help out! It's Angelic Buster time!

0.0: Dearest Angelic Buster, the city needs you! Please come and find me.

1.0: Magnus has launched his forces far earlier than we expected. Kaiser is seeing to some Specters east of the shields, and our forces are still scrambling to positions...
1.1: I don't want to ask you to do anything unladylike... but I will ask you this once, to join us in the defense of Pantheon. Please, be our guardian angel.

yes.0: You are a glimpse into the heavens above. I'll get you up to speed on the situation later. Wait here for now.
